description: This file defines the SMTP class within the Opencart system, providing methods for configuring and sending emails via SMTP protocol, including connection handling, message formatting, and error handling.

classes.name: Smtp
classes.description: A class providing SMTP email sending functionalities, including message composition, server connection, authentication, and message transmission with support for attachments and TLS encryption.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes SMTP object with optional configuration options provided as key-value pairs.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender's name or address.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text message body.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Constructs and transmits the email message via SMTP, handling server connection, authentication, TLS, and error checking.

methods.name: handleReply
methods.description: Handles reading responses from the SMTP server, with retries for slow responses, and checks expected reply codes.
